description: This file defines a Perl module 'Git' providing an interface to Git version control system, including methods for executing Git commands, managing repositories, handling credentials, and processing Git objects.

classes.name: Git::Error::Command
classes.description: Exception class for errors returned by external Git commands.

methods.name: repository
methods.description: Constructs a new Git repository object, determining repository and working copy paths.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Executes a Git command, returning output as string or array.

methods.name: command_oneline
methods.description: Executes a Git command and returns the first line of output.

methods.name: command_output_pipe
methods.description: Executes a command and returns a pipe to read its output.

methods.name: command_input_pipe
methods.description: Executes a command and returns a pipe for input.

methods.name: command_close_pipe
methods.description: Closes a pipe returned by command_output_pipe or command_input_pipe.

methods.name: command_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Executes a command and returns pipes for bidirectional communication.

methods.name: command_close_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Closes pipes from command_bidi_pipe and checks command success.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the current Git version.

methods.name: exec_path
methods.description: Returns the path to Git's executable directory.

methods.name: html_path
methods.description: Returns the path to Git's HTML documentation.

methods.name: hash_object
methods.description: Computes SHA1 hash of a file considering it as a Git object.

methods.name: hash_and_insert_object
methods.description: Hashes a file and inserts it into the Git object database.

methods.name: cat_blob
methods.description: Outputs the contents of a Git blob to a filehandle.

methods.name: remote_refs
methods.description: Retrieves refs from a remote repository.

methods.name: ident
methods.description: Retrieves and parses author or committer ident info.

methods.name: ident_person
methods.description: Returns name and email from ident info.

methods.name: credential
methods.description: Handles Git credentials operations.

methods.name: credential_read
methods.description: Reads credential key-value pairs from a filehandle.

methods.name: credential_write
methods.description: Writes credential key-value pairs to a filehandle.

methods.name: temp_acquire
methods.description: Retrieves and locks a temporary file by name.

methods.name: temp_is_locked
methods.description: Checks if a temp file is locked.

methods.name: temp_release
methods.description: Releases a lock on a temp file.

methods.name: temp_reset
methods.description: Truncates and resets a temp file handle.

methods.name: temp_path
methods.description: Returns filename associated with a temp file handle.

methods.name: unquote_path
methods.description: Unquotes a c-escaped path string.

methods.name: get_comment_line_char
methods.description: Gets the comment line character from Git config.

methods.name: comment_lines
methods.description: Prefixes lines with comment character.
